newsitem.title: UK: Copper remains near highs in LME evening.
newsitem.headline: Copper remains near highs in LME evening.

text.p: Copper prices remained near their highs during Wednesday evening LME trading, building on the earlier rally that was induced by shortcovering, traders said.
At 1900 gmt three months was indicated at $2,163/68 a tonne, up from Tuesday's close of $2,136, and nicely poised to test resistance at $2,175/80.
Also behind today's gains was the tightness surrounding the December date next week, with high backwardations remaining in place, they said.
Aluminium was indicated at a steadier $1,532/34 a tonne, with shortcovering also underpinning this market.
